name: Map HUD
notes: On the menu map outside the Green Meadow (no panel, so the whole screen stays in view). Bottom left: A, B and R with the charge circles of the monster's 3 moves, as in a run. Bottom right: LV7 and the HP bar (green, yellow at half, red at a quarter). Top middle, in the thin gold letters: the land's name for 3 s when the monster walks into it (EMBER CRATER); what a gate needs while it stands by it (ONLY FIRE CAN BURN THIS); on walking into a challenge screen whose monster is still trapped, for 3 s, the garden items its fight is tuned for (BRING 5 GARDEN ITEMS / YOU HAVE 3). Middle, in the same gold letters, when a monster is freed: <NAME> UNLOCKED! / PICK IT IN THE CAVE.
